Financing rooftop solar in Goa

The Government of Goa announced a rooftop programme in 2023. The government expects private lenders to fund most of it. The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) offers a central subsidy, and the ministry has asked states to simplify approvals.

A typical 3 kW system costs about ₹1,80,000 before subsidy. International lenders quote prices in dollars: a 1 MW portfolio costs about $650,000. The state has budgeted ₹2,50,00,000 for interest subvention this year.

Applications can be posted to the Directorate, Panaji 403001, or filed online. The office at Altinho handles about 3200 files a year, and 2,450 were cleared in 2023.

We recommend three changes. We recommend a single online form. We also recommend a fixed deadline for approvals.
